C1318.title: Fileless Attack Analysis in Incident Response
C1318.summary: On September 10, 2019, an internal server was hit by a fileless cryptomining attack. The attacker used SMB password brute force to deliver the payload and kept mining code running in memory through PowerShell. Analysis also found scanning of ports 445 and 65529, lateral propagation, scheduled downloads of malicious files, and exploitation of MS17-010 for further spread.
